import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
for c in cands:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[c,'species_richness'])
    m = smf.ols(f'species_richness ~ {c} + C(region)', data=d).fit()
    print(f"{c:15s} coef={m.params[c]:8.4f} se={m.bse[c]:7.4f} t={m.tvalues[c]:7.3f} p={m.pvalues[c]:.4g} n={len(d)}")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf

cands = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
d = df.dropna(subset=cands+['species_richness'])
print("n full:", len(d))
m = smf.ols('species_richness ~ ' + ' + '.join(cands) + ' + C(region)', data=d).fit()
print(m.summary().tables[1])
# slope by region
print(d.groupby('region')['slope_deg'].describe())
print(d.groupby('region')['species_richness'].mean())
